item.title: TRUSTY IBROX RETURN?
item.description: AUSTON TRUSTY will almost certainly return to Celtic’s central defence for Sunday’s Scottish Cup quarter-final encounter at Ibrox. The USA international is NOT banned from the Cup competition after sitting out the champions’ 2-2 draw at the same venue on Sunday and the 2-1 win over Aberdeen at Pittodrie last night.
